#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
# MVLITE_PART_11_API_MANAGER_PHASE1
# Generic price API manager - Phase 1

set -e

PART_NAME="MVLITE_PART_11_API_MANAGER_PHASE1"
PROJECT_DIR="$HOME/mvlite_bot"
APP_FILE="$PROJECT_DIR/app.py"

if [ ! -d "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $PROJECT_DIR not found."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$APP_FILE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $APP_FILE not found."
  exit 1
fi

BACKUP_FILE="$PROJECT_DIR/app_backup_before_api_phase1_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).py"
cp "$APP_FILE" "$BACKUP_FILE"

echo "" | base64 -d | python - "$APP_FILE"

cat > "$PROJECT_DIR/PART_11_API_MANAGER_PHASE1_README.txt" <<'TXT'
MVLite Part 11 - API Manager Phase 1

Added:
- Price API section in admin panel
- Enable/disable API
- API display name
- Base URL
- API Key
- Configurable authentication header and prefix
- Configurable test endpoint and timeout
- Connection test
- Masked API Key display
- Last connection-test result
- /priceapi admin command

Phase 2:
Symbols/currencies list and live prices will be added after the actual API documentation or JSON response is provided.
TXT

python -m py_compile "$APP_FILE"

echo "=============================================="
echo "Done: $PART_NAME applied."
echo "Syntax check: OK"
echo "Backup:"
echo "  $BACKUP_FILE"
echo "=============================================="
echo "Deploy with:"
echo "  cd ~/mvlite_bot"
echo "  git add ."
echo "  git commit -m \"Add price API manager phase 1\""
echo "  git push"
